scope: Current encounter/card/Vocabulary Matrix/Rest/repository discussion, with links to earlier preserved algorithm catalogs; not a claim to exhaustively recover the archives.

proposals.title: Encounter-to-index protocol
proposals.discussion_context: An encountered word/symbol routes through ע perception and ר recognition to its established index stack; an unfamiliar term starts a candidate stack.
proposals.unresolved: Do not equate matrix presence with comprehension.

proposals.title: Definition-backed acquisition card
proposals.discussion_context: צ pulls a fresh index card; its back holds a sourced definition. Words in that definition are marked green/red for demonstrated understanding/presence or outstanding learning.
proposals.unresolved: How are unresolved senses displayed without falsely claiming understanding?

proposals.title: Vocabulary Matrix with sense-scoped admission
proposals.discussion_context: Separate encountered candidate vocabulary from senses admitted for particular uses. Keep a single retrievable Matrix rather than treating text exposure as admission.
proposals.unresolved: Recognition, retrieval, composition, inference and execution need distinct qualifications.

proposals.title: Per-word comprehension and usage qualification
proposals.discussion_context: Require sense discrimination, examples/counterexamples, contrast, contextual use, grammar, inference limits, uncertainty, retention and transfer as applicable.
proposals.dependencies: PA-003; independent references and held-out tasks
proposals.unresolved: No finite test establishes complete comprehension; define bounded demonstrated competence.

proposals.title: Context/use-case card capture
proposals.discussion_context: Record actual conversational occurrences and dictionary examples as context cards, with role, source, situation, sense and relation to existing cards.
proposals.unresolved: A quoted example, user report and observed outcome are different evidence kinds.

proposals.title: ת record / צ attachment lifecycle
proposals.discussion_context: Create a blank context card, record its contribution/status through the proposed ת workflow, then צ-link it to the word stack.
proposals.unresolved: Existing ת is associative stamping; allocating/filling/sealing context cards is not implemented by that method.

proposals.title: Context novelty and repetition handling
proposals.discussion_context: Link repeated encounters to existing context evidence; create new cards for distinct examples, qualifications, contradictions and questions.
proposals.unresolved: Repeated claims are not independent corroboration; deduplication must preserve occurrences.

proposals.title: Replaceable sense slots and revision-pinned context
proposals.origin: Timothy earlier index-card model; Codex proposal
proposals.discussion_context: Keep stable word identity while replacing an active interpretation; context records pin the sense revision used and retain alternatives.
proposals.dependencies: PA-003; PA-005; existing card revision history
proposals.unresolved: Do not rewrite old context when a new sense card occupies the slot.

proposals.title: Common index-card representation with adaptive policies
proposals.discussion_context: Reuse general cards as records; adaptivity belongs to selection, activation, replacement and evidence policies.
proposals.unresolved: Tower code currently allows user commands and Self/Julian scopes only.

proposals.title: Echo-operated adapter experiment bridge
proposals.discussion_context: Let Echo propose, activate experimentally, compare, revise and retain context/retrieval/algorithm configurations.
proposals.unresolved: User-only actor labels must not be bypassed; trial logging does not automatically adapt selection.

proposals.title: Rest controller and consolidation
proposals.discussion_context: When no external task is active, Rest consolidates recorded experience and supports hypotheses and algorithm trials over accessible material.
proposals.unresolved: Rest is active computation; preserve originals and interrupt safely for a new task.

proposals.title: Experiment-objective selection
proposals.discussion_context: Select research questions from gaps, contradictions, untried compatible compositions and transfer checks.
proposals.unresolved: A-101 chooses supplied arms; it does not choose a worthwhile objective from arbitrary cards.

proposals.title: Bounded block-composition search
proposals.discussion_context: Reuse MOD-0002 search/replay for eligible typed glyph-block compositions against explicit predicates.
proposals.dependencies: Implementation bindings; immutable/copy trial state; PA-012
proposals.unresolved: Trusted callables can mutate inputs or hang; search bounds alone are not isolation.

proposals.title: Typed governed experiment executor
proposals.discussion_context: Resolve allowed implementations, types and preconditions; isolate trial state; record traces, cancellation, invariants and outcomes.
proposals.unresolved: A named glyph or source description never grants execution authority.

proposals.title: Selection feedback without repeated-failure starvation
proposals.discussion_context: Separate attempted-arm exploration from trusted successful evidence; preserve failed trials so a rejected generation does not repeat one arm indefinitely.
proposals.unresolved: Must compare policies and preserve the existing baseline; do not silently alter protected core.

proposals.title: Up/down experiment-priority votes
proposals.discussion_context: Use attributable votes to prioritize eligible experiments, with anti-inflation and exploration slots.
proposals.unresolved: Timothy said Maybe; not adopted as the settled priority algorithm. Votes are not truth.

proposals.title: Standard source-to-card intake
proposals.discussion_context: Represent incoming documents, passages, lexical senses, claims, observations and algorithms with appropriate source-linked card types.
proposals.unresolved: Do not atomize every input into disconnected word cards or drop original artifacts.

proposals.title: Library candidate-to-lexical-contract admission
proposals.discussion_context: Connect the 210 preserved library candidates to explicit sense-aware dictionary/interface records without promoting prose to executable logic.
proposals.unresolved: Current raw indexing creates associations but no new WordAgents.

proposals.title: Recursive Return sentence and topic engine
proposals.discussion_context: Suspend unresolved positions/branches, return with new evidence, preserve original sequence and revision relationships; revisit topics during Rest.
proposals.dependencies: Stable position IDs; continuation state; evidence
proposals.unresolved: Current bounded reflection is not a complete suspended-continuation implementation.

proposals.title: Repository inventory and change-management assistant
proposals.discussion_context: Track files, directories, registries, matrices, algorithms and dependencies as entities; detect add/edit/rename/delete before proposing changes.
proposals.unresolved: Lexical identity and repository-entity identity are distinct; source observation is not permission to write.

proposals.title: Timeline assistance as developmental curriculum
proposals.discussion_context: Develop observation, attribution, classification, comprehension, inference, sentence construction and transfer through source-linked milestones.
proposals.unresolved: Paused by Timothy while foundations and dictionary intake are addressed.

proposals.title: ע perception / ר identification vocabulary portfolios
proposals.discussion_context: Keep perception and recognition/identification senses available to their tool stacks, with פ naming and ת labeling distinct.
proposals.dependencies: Existing five source-sense clips; candidate vocabulary
proposals.unresolved: Existing match comparison is not identity proof; missing source definitions remain acquisition targets.

proposals.title: Generalization and specification with role preservation
proposals.discussion_context: Compose with general candidates, specialize with evidence, and generalize sentences while keeping stable positions, roles and alternatives.
proposals.dependencies: Sense evidence; subtype direction; sentence-card history
proposals.unresolved: Positive existential transformations are bounded; universal/negative transfer must not be assumed.

proposals.title: Relational evaluator propagation
proposals.discussion_context: Investigate linked discrete evaluators {✓, X, =, ≈, ≠, ±, <, >}, contradiction handling and fixed-point propagation instead of unrelated decimal weights.
proposals.dependencies: Explicit evaluator semantics and domain constraints
proposals.unresolved: Hydraulic/gravitational descriptions are analogies; the four-token NVE-D alphabet is a separate provisional protocol.
